Whether account action is warranted is not decided by profile facts; NS-2's flag condition (tap made while outside the pickup radius) is not met because the tap was at 41 m [F6][NS-2].

The driver's account is not wholly contradicted: the tap in [F6] is a system record consistent with the GPS position at that moment [F1], so [F10][F12] are corroborative, not decisive [NS-1].

Traffic and weather facts are irrelevant to the no-show fee question; no reroute justification is at issue [F14][F15][NS-1].
